description:
By chance, Choi Yoonjae comes into possession of Kang Seongho hyung’s wedding ring. Returning it would have been the end of the matter.

But on a sudden impulse, Yoonjae hides the ring - and finds himself confronting a darkness under Seongho’s watchful eyes that must never be revealed.

Is it loyalty, obsession… or a desire he hasn’t even admitted to himself? What awaits at the end of this dangerous relationship?

---
